text: Time t0 get Recipe of the Day Notification

summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is from the "Settings" menu of an application. The main contents and functions available on this screen are:

1. **Change Language**: An option to change the language of the application, currently set to "EN" (English).
2. **Recipe of the Day**: A toggle option to enable or disable notifications for the "Recipe of the Day." It is currently enabled (checked).
   - **Time to get Recipe of the Day Notification**: The time set for receiving the "Recipe of the Day" notification, which is 4:00 PM.
3. **Shopping Reminder**: A toggle option to enable or disable notifications for "Shopping Reminder." It is currently disabled (unchecked).
   - **Time to show Shopping Reminder Notification**: The time set for receiving the "Shopping Reminder" notification, which is 4:00 PM.

The screen allows users to customize their notification preferences and language settings.
